ValidationRule.description: #21305- Changed the Formula to make this VR applicable for all profiles and to restrict users from adding Products on Won Opportunities #20656- Added bypass logic to edit Products in late stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( Amount ), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed')), NOT( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName), '4 - Negotiate') ),
NOT( $Permission.Edit_Product_Amount_in_Late_Stage_Opp ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the Product details once an Opportunity has been Won. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
